name: de.zug-ticket-kaufen/bahn-zuverlaessigkeit
title: Bahn-Zuverlässigkeits-MCP
description: German railway reliability: punctuality, delays, and passenger-rights compensation (EU 2021/782).

tools.name: route_punctuality
tools.description: Punctuality statistics for a train route between two German stations (on-time percentage, average delay, cancellation rate, observation count). Uses partial matching so "Berlin" and "München" work (omit "Hbf" or suffixes).

from.description: Origin station name (German), e.g. "Berlin Hbf" or just "Berlin". Partial match supported.

to.description: Destination station name (German), e.g. "München Hbf" or just "München". Partial match supported.

tools.name: station_punctuality
tools.description: Punctuality statistics for a single German station: on-time percentage, average delay, cancellation rate, number of distinct trains observed. Uses partial matching: "Frankfurt Hbf" matches "Frankfurt(Main)Hbf".

station.description: Station name (German), e.g. "Berlin Hbf", "München Hbf". Partial match supported (omit parenthetical suffixes).

tools.name: train_delay_stats
tools.description: Delay statistics for a specific train (e.g. ICE 577): per-station on-time percentage, average/max delay and cancellation rate. Useful to answer "how reliable is this exact train?". Returns a compact station list (default 15, max 50) for token efficiency.

station_limit.description: Max stations to return (default 15, max 50). Overall stats always included.

tools.name: chaos_index
tools.description: The Bahn-Chaos-Index: ONE number (0 calm ... 100 chaos) summarizing the state of German rail TODAY: long-distance arrivals at 20 major stations, compared with the median of the previous 28 days up to the same time of day (punctuality 50%, cancellations 30%, average delay 20%). Returns the index, the baseline, a label (ruhig/erhoeht/angespannt/chaotisch) and the underlying components. Citable: https://www.zug-ticket-kaufen.de/bahn-chaos-index

tools.name: compensation_calculator
tools.description: Calculate the compensation a passenger is owed for a delayed German train under EU regulation 2021/782 / DB Fahrgastrechte: 25% of the fare from 60 minutes delay, 50% from 120 minutes. Season tickets (except BahnCard 100) collect delays of 20+ minutes and pay one flat rate per full 60 minutes of total delay; BahnCard 100 pays one flat rate per delay case of 60+ minutes. Returns gross amount, payout (after the 4 EUR minimum) and the applied rate.

delay_minutes.description: Delay at the destination in minutes

fare_eur.description: Fare paid in EUR (required for single tickets)

round_trip_total.description: true if fare_eur is the TOTAL for a round trip (basis is halved)

delay_count.description: Number of like delays of "delay_minutes" each to combine (season tickets, default 1). Non-BahnCard-100: their minutes are summed (each must be 20+); BahnCard 100: counted as cases (each must be 60+).

ticket_value_eur.description: Season-ticket value in EUR — payouts are capped at 25% of it
